verses.text: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations whose land he’s giving you, and you take their place and settle in their towns and homes,
set apart three towns in the middle of the land Yahweh your God is giving you to own.
Prepare the roads and divide the land Yahweh your God is giving you into three regions. That way anyone who kills someone can run to one of those towns.
Here’s who may run there and live: someone who kills a neighbor by accident and had never hated them before.

Say a person goes into the woods with a neighbor to chop wood. They swing the ax at a tree, but the ax head slips off the handle, hits the neighbor, and kills them. The person who swung the ax can run to one of those towns and live.

Otherwise the avenger of blood might chase after that person in a rage. If the road is too long, the avenger could catch them and kill them, even though they didn’t deserve to die because they never hated their neighbor.
That’s why I’m telling you to set apart three towns.
If Yahweh your God expands your borders as he swore to your ancestors and gives you all the land he promised them,
and you follow everything I’m commanding you today, loving Yahweh your God and always walking in his ways, add three more towns to those first three.
That way innocent blood won’t be shed in the land Yahweh your God gives you as an inheritance, and you won’t be guilty of bloodshed.
But suppose someone hates a neighbor, lies in wait, attacks and kills them, and then runs to one of those towns.
The elders of that person’s own town must send for them, bring them back, and hand them over to the avenger of blood to be put to death.
Don’t pity that person. Clear Israel of the guilt for innocent blood, so things will go well for you.
Don’t move your neighbor’s boundary marker. It was set there long ago in the land you’ll inherit, the land Yahweh your God is giving you to own.
One witness alone can’t establish that someone is guilty of a wrongdoing or a sin. It takes the testimony of two or three witnesses to establish the matter.
Suppose a dishonest witness comes forward and accuses someone of wrongdoing.
Both people in the dispute must stand before Yahweh, before the priests and judges serving at the time.
The judges must investigate carefully. If the witness has lied and given false testimony against their fellow Israelite,
do to the witness what they meant to do to the other person. That’s how you’ll remove the evil from among you.
The rest of the people will hear about it and be afraid to do anything that evil among you again.
Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
